entries.title: Automatic gives your other computer only models it can run
entries.body: A computer that runs work now lists the Claude models offered there, and only the Codex and Grok models its own accounts serve, as this computer does. Before, it listed every model the app knows for each, so Automatic could send it a task on a model its sign-in there does not serve. Update that computer too.
entries.noPicture: No screen changes: Task Details already say which computer and model Automatic chose.
